high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post by Bobby Tatro, who is identified as a former Walmart Employee of the Month. The post was made 2 hours ago and has received 6 upvotes. The content of the post is a question about what common item today will baffle archaeologists when they dig it up in a thousand years. It humorously notes that this is the same question archaeologists were asking in Baghdad about 2000 years ago. Below the text, there is an image of two clay jars labeled "The Baghdad Battery."
